{b.jugend_befoerderung_vorschlag_gruss} {b.jugend_befoerderung_vorschlag_lage} It is not a matter of the hour, but my gut tells me he is ready.

{b.jugend_ohne_spiele_gruss} {b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage} They urgently need to play, in whatever form. Tell me what you can imagine.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.e.e3: {b.jugend_ohne_spiele_gruss} {b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage} I know you have plenty else on your mind. But these lads have nobody but us.
{b.jugend_ohne_spiele_gruss} {b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage} The moment could hardly be worse, yet the lads cannot wait for better times.
pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.e.e4: {b.jugend_ohne_spiele_gruss} {b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage} Either the lads play or I throw in my share of the work, it is that simple!
{b.jugend_ohne_spiele_gruss} {b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage} I do not want to hear excuses any more, I want appearances for my people!

{b.jugend_ohne_spiele_gruss} {b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage} More than one is already thinking about a move just so he can finally play.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a1: We register the lads for the reserve team's fixtures. There they get real matches week after week.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a2: We arrange friendlies against neighbouring clubs. The lads get match practice, and it costs us little.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a4: Whoever finds no place here is loaned out. He should play somewhere rather than wither with us.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a5: I will talk to the lads myself. They should know that we see them and that I take their situation seriously.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a6: The assistant coach goes through the schedule of the coming weeks with you. If you find gaps, you close them.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a7: Give me a few more weeks until the situation in the squad has cleared. Then we will see.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a8: At least the view gets trained on the bench, that never hurts. But you are right, I will take care of it.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a9: That is not my problem. Whoever does not play has only himself to blame.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a10: I do not change my line-up to suit the academy's wishes. That was so, and it stays so.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.a.a12: I cannot pay for additional matches at the moment. The budget does not allow it, and that is no ill will.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.r.r1: {b.gut} That finally gives the lads something to work for again.
{b.gut} I can tell you take their situation seriously, thank you for that.
pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.r.r2: {b.gut} Exactly what I had counted on from you, we pull on the same rope.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.r.r3: {b.gut} With competition they will grow, and you will feel that in the table.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.r.r4: {b.neutral} That helps a little, but the lads will stay impatient all the same.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.r.r5: {b.neutral} I hope the lads do not see a rebuff in it, they are very sensitive right now.

pool.jugend_ohne_spiele.r.r6: {b.neutral} We will see how it develops, I need not hurry you.
